# Pyodide 0.27.2 (vendored)

Pyodide is free, open-source software (Apache License 2.0) that runs Python in the web browser.
It lets the website run the real MK.Buildings Python agents (`site/py/mk_agents/`) for the chat,
with no server and no paid service.

- Project: https://pyodide.org
- Source / license: https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide (Apache-2.0)
- Files copied unchanged from the npm package `pyodide@0.27.2`.
